actions.summary: Re-deliver an already-settled Hunt capture acknowledgement.
actions.requires: the signer's open Hunt has a durable settlement receipt
actions.pays: nothing; this is idempotent delivery recovery only

actions.spends: the Rune bid AND one Scroll, whether the binding holds or breaks
refusals: Capture does not match an open hunt
Hunt process is not assigned to this run
Settlement id belongs to another capture
You do not hold enough Runes for that capture bid
actions.summary: Settle one capture attempt. Emitted by the Hunt worker, never signed by a player.
actions.requires: an open run this process assigned, rune >= bid, scroll >= scrollCost
actions.pays: on success, the exact defeated creature into the collection
actions.note: Idempotent on settlement-id: a retry is acknowledged, never paid twice. Both prices are checked before either is spent, because the worker retries a refusal and a half-charge would be charged again.

actions.summary: Open one crate and take what is in it.

actions.note: Omit Rarity and the BEST crate on hand is opened, not the first.

actions.summary: Send the companion away for an hour. The slow, safe verb.
actions.requires: status Home, no other activity, energy >= 25, happiness >= 25
actions.pays: exp, and Gold from the shared 20-hour allowance -- no items
actions.then: Monster.Claim, once the duration has elapsed
actions.note: Items come from the daily crate, never from a verb. A quest paid a crate until 2026-09-06 and that was the largest unintended faucet in the economy.
